subject: Civil Engineering
title: Look-Ahead Schedules
description: A quick win: understand Look-Ahead Schedules.

hook.text: The master schedule spans years. But what exactly happens next week? That's the look-ahead.

buildup.text: A look-ahead schedule covers 2-6 weeks — detailed daily tasks with specific crews assigned.

discovery.text: It identifies constraints — missing materials, pending inspections, prerequisite work — before they block.

twist.text: The Last Planner System asks foremen to commit only to tasks they're certain they can complete.

climax.text: Tracking percent plan complete (PPC) measures reliability — high PPC means a predictable site.

punchline.text: The master schedule plans the dream. The look-ahead plans reality.

quiz.question: What does the Last Planner System ask foremen to do?
options: Complete tasks as fast as possible regardless of quality
Commit only to tasks they're certain they can complete, improving schedule reliability
Work overtime to catch up with the master schedule

details.summary: Look-ahead schedules are short-term plans covering the next two to six weeks that break master schedule activities into daily work assignments. They identify constraints like material deliveries, permits, and crew availability that must be resolved before work can proceed as planned.
details.whyItMatters: Look-ahead planning bridges the gap between the master schedule and daily field work, ensuring that every upcoming activity has its prerequisites satisfied before crews arrive to start work.
takeaways: Look-aheads typically cover a rolling two to six week planning window
They identify and remove constraints before they cause work stoppages
Weekly look-ahead meetings drive accountability for constraint removal

faq.question: How does a look-ahead schedule differ from the master project schedule?
faq.answer: The master schedule shows the overall project plan with hundreds or thousands of activities spanning months or years. The look-ahead schedule zooms into the next few weeks, breaking each activity into detailed daily tasks and identifying specific prerequisites like material deliveries, inspections.

faq.question: What is constraint analysis in look-ahead planning?
faq.answer: Constraint analysis identifies every prerequisite needed before a planned activity can start: materials ordered and on site, permits obtained, preceding work complete, equipment mobilized, labor available, and drawings issued.
